method: LOAD_WINDOW and LEA32 compute base + (index << scale) + displacement at runtime. LOAD_WINDOW reads only inside its host-approved physical RAM page and exits before changing state otherwise. The host helper accepts only a preexisting translation-cache hit for a flat DS page in ordinary RAM above 1 MiB, then rechecks translation identity and generation, CR0/CR3/CR4, segment cache, A20 and board RAM classification at entry. It does not walk an uncached page or execute guest instructions.
validation: Rebuilt WASM byte-identically using the same output basename. node --test test/i80386*.test.mjs before the last focused addition: 347 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed. The final focused test file passed 10 tests. Tests compare changing SIB MOV/LEA and a protected-mode high virtual page with the JavaScript 386, verify no early page-walk side effects, reject a stale window after a board page-table write, and stop before a later out-of-window load while retaining earlier retirement.
scope: Experimental prevalidated IR and host read-window admission only. No guest opcode decoder, production AT integration, native writes, exact guest fault path or end-to-end speedup claim.
